title: Portable Solar Recharge Recovery
dataSources: Victron telemetry (`victron:telemetry`), iOverlander place logs (`ioverlander:place`), Garmin inReach messages (`inreach:message`), and Mopeka propane readings (`mopeka:tank`).
app: Victron Cerbo GX telemetry, iOverlander place exports, Garmin inReach check-ins, and Mopeka propane sensors streamed into Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=victron:telemetry solar_input_watts=* battery_soc_pct=*
| sort 0 _time
| streamstats current=f last(battery_soc_pct) as prev_soc by system_name
| eval soc_gain=round(battery_soc_pct-prev_soc,1)
| where solar_input_watts>100 AND soc_gain>0
| stats avg(soc_gain) as avg_soc_gain, avg(charge_minutes) as avg_charge_minutes by system_name
| sort - avg_soc_gain
description: Measures how quickly the off-grid power system recovers charge when portable solar input is available.
value: Recharge recovery tells you whether portable panels and battery settings are actually buying you resilience at camp.
implementation: Forward Victron solar and battery fields into Splunk and calculate charge gain after each meaningful solar window.
visualization: Table of systems with average SOC gain and charge duration.
grandmaExplanation: It tracks how well your solar setup refills the battery when the sun finally shows up.
